brief:
Build a new Prism app from one sentence and publish it, or load, run, inspect and verify a holo, the Prism package that carries its own proof and provenance. Use when asked to build, start or ship a Prism app, when a task mentions Prism, LexLean, a .holo file or prism-code, or when it asks whether an application can be trusted before it runs.

Prism works like Docker. A model is built into a holo, an immutable package addressed by its digest, like an image. A runtime runs the holo, like a container runtime runs an image, and every run starts from a loaded, verified instance, like a container. A holo carries its own proof and provenance, so you check it before anything runs.

| Docker | Prism | | --- | --- | | Dockerfile | model | | image, tag and digest | holo | | container | instance | | base image pinned in `FROM` | SDK image pinned in the lockfile | | `docker run` | `prism-code run` | | `docker inspect` | `prism-code inspect` |
